description: This file defines URL patterns for the Django application's 'core' API endpoints, mapping URL paths to specific API view classes for handling requests related to products, orders, coupons, refunds, and health checks.

classes.name: HealthAPIView
classes.description: API view for health check endpoint

classes.name: PublicItemListAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing public items

classes.name: PublicItemDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for retrieving details of a public item

classes.name: MyOrdersListAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing user's orders

classes.name: MyOrderDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for retrieving details of a specific order

classes.name: AdminItemListCreateAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing and creating admin items

classes.name: AdminItemDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for retrieving, updating, or deleting a specific admin item

classes.name: AdminCouponListCreateAPIView
classes.description: API view for listing and creating coupons

classes.name: AdminCouponDetailAPIView
classes.description: API view for detailed coupon operations

classes.name: AdminOrderStatusTransitionAPIView
classes.description: API view for transitioning order statuses

classes.name: AdminRefundModerationAPIView
classes.description: API view for refund moderation actions

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Method to convert class-based views into callable view functions
